chunks: That is God, your Lord, the Creator of everything. There is no god but He. How then do you turn away?
ai.seo_question: Who is the Creator of everything according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ghafir, this verse establishes the foundational creed of Tawhid by linking Allah’s role as the sole Creator (Khaliq) with His exclusive right to worship. Shia exegetes often highlight the rhetorical question 'an na tu'fakun' (how are you deluded?) as a call to reflect on the natural disposition (Fitrah) that recognizes this truth, yet is obscured by societal or ego-driven deviations.
